book.name: 1 Korint
book.title: Nzryr-krbz Pol Kx Ayrnrngr Mz Lr Korint

content: Gct Kabzle Zmatq Kxmyapxbzng Mz Leplz Nedeng Mz Nzaxplr-lzbq-krdr
Mz nzmu-krde lcde, drtqmu navq zvz mz nzmrlzti-krmu leplz. X mzli lcpwz nasuti kz drtwrmu nztwz-krmu zmatq ngr nzwztr-krbzmu mz Gct, myapxbz zmatq ngr nzrplzpxngr nrpa kx kabz Gct.
Mzli ka suti drtwrmu kx leplz amrlx naycmnebzng mz Gct mz natq lr mrkzbleng. A' doa kxmule lc trycmnepwzu mz lrmakxtr. Murde mqngr doa lc ycmnetr-ngrde da kx yc-kapq x leplz trnzkrlzlru drtwr ngrde.
A' mzli kc leplz nzlalztq-ngrbzlr mz doa kx plzpxle nrpa kx kabz Gct, nrpa lc axplrle nzrlxngiti-krdr, apqtrle drtwrdr, x amqtr-kzpzle drtwrdr.
Mrlx kc tqycmnebz mz Gct mz natq lr mrkzbleng, okatrle nide esz'-krde. A' mrlx kc tqplzpxle nrpa kx kabz Gct, okatrle lrmakxtr atwrnrngr.

Suti drtwrnge kx nimu amrlx nakrlzamu nzycmne-krbzmu mz Gct mz natq lr mrkzbleng. A' sutitx zlwz drtwrnge kx naplzpxamu nrpa kx kabz Gct. Murde mrlx kx plzpxle nrpa kx kabz Gct, nzokatr-krde lrmakxtr myaszpxle mrlx kx ycmne txpwz mz Gct mz natq lr mrkzbleng, a' trpipx-kzleu drtwr ngrde. A' nzmu napipx-kzle drtwr ngrde, mrlx lcng li nzrsakrlrng mz nzokatr-krdr lrmakxtr.

Mzlengeng x inwengeng, nzmu naycmnebo mz Gct mz natq lr mrkzbleng, mz nzyrlwr-lxblr-krgu, trkrlzleu nzokatr-krde nimu. Murde mz nzokatr-krnge nimu naycmnebo bamu mz natq kx krlzamu, mz nzyapwxtipx-krbo bamu da kxyc-kapq kx aelwapx-ngrm Gct bange, o mz nzpipx-krbo nrpa ngr nzrkrlzngr, o mz nzplzpx-krbo nrpa kx kam Gct bange, o mz nzalvztr-krnge natq Gct.
Na-aoti drtwrmu nzyrnikr gita. Nzmu trnzamqngi-zpwxu nqvi lrdeng, rblx nzkrlz-krmu nabz kc tzayrningr gita kc, x trokatrleu nimu nzngr-krmu nabz lc.
X na-aoti kz drtwrmu ngrlrvea nzvxutr-krde trpu. Nzmu natqde trnaopxleu, rblxbz mz ncblo ngr vea nedeng nzoliqti-krdr nzotangr.
Kxmu-kzle lc mzli kc tqangio-ngrnamu. Nzmu natq ncblo kx trpnzngr kx rkrlz, rblx nzokatr-krde leplz. Nzycmnekr ncblo kxmule lcde mane, murde vz lxlrtxngr.
Da zpwxtx kx natq kqlu mrka mz nrlc, x natq lcdeng amrlx kzdung leplz nzyrplatitr nardr.
A' mz nzycmnekr ncblo mz natq kx trkrlzwxu, apumle bange lr mrkzble, x apu-kzpo bade lr mrkzble, murde trkrlzkru nzycmne-etr-krgr.
Kxmu-kzle lc mz nimu. Mz nzvqtikr drtqmu zmatq ngr nzwzngr lcng, mrlz nzsuti-kzkr drtwrmu zmatq ngr nzaxplrngr lrmakxtr.
Mz nzmu-krde lcde, ncblo kx twzpele zmatq ngr nzycmne-ngrbz mz Gct mz natq lr mrkzbleng, nakrka'-ngrbzle bade zmatq ngr nzrpipxngr drtwr ngr natq lr mrkzble lcng.
Murde mzli kc tqycmne-ngrbo mz Gct mz natq lr mrkzbleng, mqngrnge krka', a' drtwrnge trprtrpwzu mz nzkrka'ngr lc.

Delc, pnzpe drtwrnge kx mqngrnge sa nakrka'bz x nangrbz mz Gct mz natq lr mrkzbleng mz nzangio-krnge nide mz nzmnc-krnge esz'-krnge. A' drtwrnge sa nakrka' x nangrbz mz Gct mz natq leplz kcng tqangio-lxblrkr badr. X navz-nqblqamu natqnge lcng.
Murde mz nzglqpx-krm Gct x nzawi-krbzme bade mz natq lr mrkzbleng, rblxbz mz kztemqng nzesz'tikr drtwrmu badr mz nzkrka'-krm lc.
X nzkrka'ngr kxmule lc, takitrde nzawi-ngrbz mz Gct, a' trokatrleu leplz.
X awi-ngrbo mz Gct kx nzycmne-krbo bade mz natq lr mrkzbleng myaszpx-zlwzle nimu. A' alex da lc mz nzmnc-krnge esz'-krnge.
Murde mz nzyrlwr-lxblrkr lrmakxtr, mz drtwrnge nzpipx-krbo mz leplz nrpa kxmrbc kx yrplatitr nardr myaszpx-zlwzle nzycmne-aboi-krbo mz Gct mz natq lr mrkzbleng, kx tryrplatitru nardr.

Mzlengeng x inwengeng, mz zmatq ngr nzwzngr lcng, bzkq apuamu doa kxnztopwzng mz nzkctitxpx-krmu zmatq ngrdr. A' na-apuamu ncblo kxbrpe mz nzwz-krmu mz zmatq lcng mz nzokatr-krmu kztemung. A' mrlz kz nzapu-krmu doa kxnztopwzng murde trpnzu drtwrdr nzprtr-zvzngr mz da kxdrka'ngr.

Mz Nzryrngrkxtr, rpi Yawe kx, “Sa naycmnebo mz leplz nengeng mz natq lr mrkzbleng. Sa nangi rkx ngr nzayrplapx-krnge nidr murde trnzlxngitilru natqngeng. Kxmule-esz', a' sa napxtxpx-zvz-ngrdr nzvz-nqblq-krdr ninge.”

Mz nzmu-krde lcde, nzycmnekr kzdq kxrlxngiti mz natq lr mrkzbleng x trpnzngr doa kx rpipx drtwr ngrde, trngiu rkx ngr nzabrtzlvzkr Gct nide. A' sa nangi kz rkx ngr nzayrplapxkr Gct kxtrnzrlxngitiung. Murde mz nzpxtxpx-krdr nzycmnengr kxnzmulr lcng, sa napxtxpx-kz-ngrdr Nrpakxmrlz, x nzprtrbeng mz nzayrplapxngr. A' nzplzpxkr kzdq kxrlxngiti nrpa kx kabz Gct bade, ngi rkx ngr nzabrtzlvzkr Gct nide, murde okatrle kxnzrlxngiting x tratrkatileu kxtrnzrlxngitiung.

Mz nzyrlwr-lxblrkr dzbe lrmakxtr nyzmu, trmrlzu nimu amrlx nzycmne-krbzmu mz Gct mz natq lr mrkzbleng. Murde nzmu kxtrnzrlxngitiung o kxtrnzkrlzlru zmatq lc, kx nzprtrpzng bamu, sa narpilr kx lukurnr-ngrnamu o aycmnele nimu drka'.

A' mrlz nimu amrlx nzplzpx-krmu nrpa kx kabz Gct bamu. Murde nrpa lcng amrlx nzkrlzlr nzprtr-krdr mz nabz leplz lcng mz nzaelwapx-krbzlr badr kx nzaleng alwx x takitrde nzayrplapxkr Gct nidr. X naokatrlr nidr mz nztekqtr-krdr nqmq nr drtwrdr mz nzlxngiti-krdr Jiszs. X sa nayrngzobzng mz Gct mz nzangio-krdr nide. X narpilr kx, “Gct sc tqmnc-zpwxbz bamu mrka.”
Nqmq Ngr Nzyrlwr-lxblrngr Kxmrlz

Mzlengeng x inwengeng, da kx navzpxmqng mz nzalvztr-krnge lc nide sele. Mz nzyrlwr-lxblr-krmu takitrde doa kxesz' mz nimu nzprtr-krde mz nzangiongr lc, mz nzrlwx-krbzle kzdq nabz kxtr, o mz nzalvztr-krbzle kzdq da, o mz nzaelwapx-krbzle kzdq da kxyc-kapq, o mz nzycmne-krbzle mz Gct mz natq lr mrkzbleng, o mz nzrpipx-krbzle drtwr ngr natq lr mrkzble lcng. Murde da kxmyapxbz nzokatr-krmu lrmakxtr atwrnrngr.
A' mz nzaki-krmu nzycmnengr, rlrtx-ngrpwo leplz nali o natq kx naycmnebz mz natq lr mrkzbleng. X trtakitrdeu nzycmne-krdr mz nzwrde kxesz'. X nangi dq doa kx napipx-zvzbzle drtwr ngr natqdrng.
A' nzmu kx trpnzngr leplz kx rkrlz nzrpipxngr drtwr ngr natq lr mrkzble lcng, e leplz kcng tzycmneng mz natq lr mrkzbleng namnc-lrping x naycmne-nabu-txpwzng esz'-krdr badr Gct.

X mou, rlrtx-ngrpwo leplz nali o natq kx narplzpxng nrpa kx kabz Gct badr. X kztedrng naobqtrpzng mz nrpa lcng mz nzrkrlzngr kx nztubqng amrlx o mwx kzdung natqdrng vz-rbr, murde drtwr ngrdr tr-rsakrlr-ngru mz Nzryrngrkxtr. Mz nibr nzycmnekr kzdq doa, vz-nqblq-mouamu nqmq lc x rlr-ngrbzmu mz kzdung kz leplz kxli o tq nzplzpx-kz-krdr nrpa kx kabz Gct badr.

Nzmu kzdq doa tulz mz nzplzpx-krde nrpa kx kabz Gct bade, x mzli lc tqycmne-ngrde, Gct ka-kzpzle kzdq kz nrpa mz kzdq kz doa, doa krali lc natulz. X krkc kai nawxbuo x namnc-lrpi mzli kxpipz mz nzrlr-ngrbz mz doa krali nzplzpx-kz-krde nrpa scde. X krkc kai sc tqplzpxpe-moule nrpa scde mz nzayrkrpx-krdele.
Mrlz leplz amrlx nzplzpx-krdr nrpa kx kabz Gct badr, murde leplz amrlx naxlrlr nrpa lcng x na-apqtrpzlr drtwrdr.
X mz zmatq ngr nzrplzpxngr nrpa kx kabz Gct badr, zmatq lc ycpebz badr mz nzaclve-krdrle. Murde Mqngrkxtr trpnzngr nzrtulrtr-krbzle mz leplz nzaelwapx-krbzlr zmatq lcng tqkabzle badr.
Murde mz dzbe lrmakxtr amrlx nyz Gct, trsutiu drtwrde lrmakxtr nzale-krdr da kx tropxu mz nzrkrlzkr leplz. A' suti drtwrde kx da amrlx namwitr-lxblrng mz nrwx.
Kzdung nimu nzvz-rbrng mz nzrpi-krmu kx, “Olvz bzkq nzycmneng mzli kc tqyrlwr-lxblr-ngrgu. A' namnclzbzng mz zmatq ngr ncblo ngrdrng, da kc tqwai nzpikr Lou sc Mosis le.
Nzmu kx tzsuti drtwr olvz nzkrlz-krdr kzdung da, naveati-krlzpwzlr mz ncblo ngrdrng mz ma nyzdrng. Murde myangr drtq olvz nzycmne-krde mz nzyrlwr-lxblrkr lrmakxtr.”
Vz-rbramu murde natq Gct trvzpxpuu bamu. Bzkq glqpx-lzbqamu mz nzrpi-krmu kx nimu txpwz kx rkrlz nzyokaetipxngr drtwr ngr natqde.
X nimu leplz kcng tzrpilr kx rngiscmu zmatq ngr nzrplzpxngr nrpa kx kabz Gct o zmatq kc-kzng tqkabz Mqngrkxtr mz leplz, nakrlzamu kx da lcng amrlx tqpipxbo bamu ngi natq kx katimqng Kxetu rgu Jiszs.
A' bzkq vz-nqblqamu doa kznike trglxleu nztubqkr natqnge lcng.
Mz nzmu-krde lcde, kx mzlengeng x inwengeng, navqti drtqmu nztwz-krmu zmatq ngr nzrplzpxngr nrpa kx kabz Gct. A' bzkq rpwa'-ngrbzmu mz leplz nzycmne-krbzlr mz Gct mz natq lr mrkzbleng.
Mz nzyrlwr-lxblr-krmu, aleamu da amrlx mz nqmq kxmrlz kx takitrde nzmnc-zpwx-krmu.

footnotes.text: Suti drtwr Gct kx leplz nedeng nakrlzlr kx ycmne-kaipz badr mz natqdr, a' nzpxtxpx-ngrdr nzvz-nqblq-krdr nide. Mz nzmu-krde lcde, ayrplapxle nidr mz nzrlr-krbzle mz lr Asiria nzaovxio-krdr nidr. X lrmrkzble lcng nzycmneng mz natq kx rblxbz mz lr Israel nzxlrngr. Natq lr mrkzbleng ngi rkx ngr nzayrplapxkr Gct kxtrnzrlxngitiung.

Kxnzetu r Nzryrngrkxtr drtwrdr tresz'tiu mz drtwr ngr ngalrde lcng li, 34-35. Mz nzrtekqtr-krgr mz Natqgu, vz-nqblqkr ncblo kcng tzrpilr kx ngalrde lcng trngiu drtwr Pol, a' ngi drtwr kzdung lr Korint. Murde natq lcng trnzesz'tiu mz kzdung kz natqdeng mz kzdung kz ngalrdeng. X mou Lou sc Mosis trpileu kx olvz bzkq nzycmneng mzli kc leplz neng Gct tzyrlwr-lxblr-ngrdr.
